name: Blue Moon

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Weak to crush with -5 flat armour, so multi-hit weapons (scythe, dual macuahuitl, glacial temotli, Torag's hammers) shine. Weapon Freeze knocks your weapon into ice blocks you punch out (Soulreaper axe loses stacks). Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

uncertain: Moons have no Attribute field in the infobox. They are not immune to ranged/magic but have +500 magic/ranged defence, so melee only is practical. Typeless slash attacks; max hit 32 total.

name: Eclipse Moon

setups.label: Melee (stab)
setups.notes: Weak to stab with +6 flat armour (rapier beats scythe). During the Clone phase parries have 100% accuracy, so swap to a slow heavy hitter (Dharok's greataxe, Soulreaper axe, Elder maul). Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

uncertain: Moons have no Attribute field in the infobox. They are not immune to ranged/magic but have +500 magic/ranged defence, so melee only is practical.

name: Blood Moon

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Weak to slash, -2 flat armour. Heals whenever it damages you, so favour defence over pure strength. Kill blood jaguars to heal back. Requires Perilous Moons. No gear is provided: bring your own melee gear; the dungeon supplies food (cooked bream/moss lizard) and moonlight potions via supply crates. Wiki stresses tanky (Barrows/Torva/Justiciar) armour over strength-only armour; defence-reducing specs and Death Charge do nothing.

uncertain: Moons have no Attribute field in the infobox. They are not immune to ranged/magic but have +500 magic/ranged defence, so melee only is practical. Hardest of the three Moons.

name: Sol Heredit

setups.label: Sol (melee slash)
setups.notes: Final wave (12) of the Fortis Colosseum, solo. No gear restrictions, but one inventory must cover all 12 waves. Don't mage or range Sol; dump Dragon claws/Burning claws below 10% HP; Saradomin godsword for healing.

setups.label: Waves (ranged)
setups.notes: The wiki's strongest first-quiver option is a Twisted bow setup; Bow of Faerdhinen + crystal armour is the budget route. Venator bow + dragon arrows for multi-target waves.

setups.label: Waves (magic)
setups.notes: A Shadow setup one-shots the melee Fremennik but has weak defence; a single trident/sang/Eye switch is enough to two-shot it.

uncertain: The Colosseum strategy page has 6 tabbed loadouts (Ranged/Mage/Budget/Melee/GM/High efficiency); merged here. Infobox has no attribute or elemental weakness. Dizana's quiver is the Colosseum's own reward, so it isn't available for a first clear.

name: The Hueycoatl

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Dragonbane works (lance) and it is weakest to crush; Inquisitor's armour recommended. Defence drain is capped at 5 levels, so bring damage specs (Crimson kisten, Dragon claws). Multi-player world boss in Darkfrost.

setups.label: Tail phase
setups.notes: The tail has a per-hit damage cap, so multi-hit crush weapons speed it up a lot.

uncertain: Infobox lists Melee/Magic/Ranged attacks but auto-attacks barely hit. The wiki gives melee setups only.

name: Amoxliatl

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Requires The Heart of Darkness. Weak to crush, -2 flat armour. Unstable ice can only be damaged by melee, so melee beats fire spells despite the 30% fire weakness. Pray Magic; thralls recommended; Slayer helmet (i) on a lesser nagua task.

uncertain: Combat 263 is the post-quest version (226 in the quest).

name: Araxxor

setups.label: Melee (crush)
setups.notes: Slayer 92 and an araxyte/spider task required. Specs: Elder maul/Dragon warhammer, Crimson kisten, Dragon claws. A Noxious halberd one-hits white araxytes; bring venom protection.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Wiki: Twisted bow + Masori beats bludgeon-tier melee but is well behind the scythe. Araxyte switches: Hunters' sunlight crossbow, Karil's crossbow, Heavy ballista, Rune crossbow.

uncertain: Infobox has no Attribute field (category Spiders/Araxytes only). The wiki ranged table lists only the Twisted bow.

name: Eldric the Ice King

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Titans are primarily meleed (wiki prioritises melee strength); Slayer helmet (i) works on ice/fire giant tasks. A halberd lets you keep hitting from the Elemental Blast safespot.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: For when the Titans are out of melee reach; their ranged defence is very high in parts of each phase.

setups.label: Magic (elementals/barriers)
setups.notes: Fire spells on Eldric's side, Water spells on Branda's. Needs 70+ magic attack bonus (39+ with void) to avoid splashing on minions, and 75 Magic to one-shot elementals with Fire/Water Wave. Twinflame staff auto-swaps fire/water.

uncertain: Eldric has no Attribute in the infobox (no 'icy' attribute). Not immune to anything but has +700 magic/ranged defence. Duo or solo; no requirements.

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Titans are primarily meleed (wiki prioritises melee strength); Slayer helmet (i) works on ice/fire giant tasks. A halberd lets you keep hitting from the Elemental Blast safespot.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: For when the Titans are out of melee reach; their ranged defence is very high in parts of each phase.

uncertain: Uses the shared Royal Titans strategy page. Not immune to anything but has +700 magic/ranged defence.

name: Yama

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Requires A Kingdom Divided; solo or duo. Weak to slash, with 120% demonbane vulnerability (Emberlight +84%). Duos: Elder maul/Dragon warhammer + Soulflame horn. Solo melee still needs a Purging staff (+Occult/Tormented) for void flares.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Only recommended with Tumeken's shadow and/or a Purging staff (flares). Magic defence rises to +60 while the target uses magic. Noxious halberd or Twisted bow as a Judge of Yama switch.

uncertain: Defence numbers are phases 1-2; phase 3 has +135 stab/+108 slash/+449 crush, light and heavy ranged/+297 standard/+81 magic. Magic defence is -30 vs a melee target, +60 vs a magic target.

name: Doom of Mokhaiotl

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Requires The Final Dawn. Ranged recommended (Magic level 275 favours the Twisted bow); elite void matches Masori with a Scorching bow and is much cheaper to reclaim. Zaryte crossbow spec is key; defence drain is capped at 60 and resets each delve; Lightbearer strongly advised.

setups.label: Melee punish
setups.notes: Doom is technically weakest to crush but melee as a main style is inadvisable. Bring a multi-hit/halberd switch for the melee-punish window (Crystal halberd spec is the budget pick).

setups.label: Larvae (demonbane melee)
setups.notes: You need a one-way swap per style for demonic larvae; Darklight is the cheapest demonbane melee option.

setups.label: Larvae (magic)
setups.notes: Autocast Superior Demonbane (Arceuus) with a Slayer's staff or Skull sceptre. Thralls not recommended (they spread acid); Death Charge is strong.

uncertain: Combat level scales by delve: 558 (delve 1) to 908 (delve 8+). No elemental weakness in infobox.

name: Scurrius

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Low-level world boss in the Varrock Sewers (combat 200 solo / 250 group). Ratbane weapons (Bone mace/shortbow/staff) are strong at mid level; mid-level alternatives: Zombie axe, Sarachnis cudgel, Dragon scimitar.

setups.label: Ranged
setups.notes: Mid-level option: Void ranger with a Bone shortbow.

setups.label: Magic
setups.notes: Mid-level: Bloodbark/Elder chaos robes with a Bone staff.

uncertain: Attacks with all three styles; no elemental weakness listed. All melee defences are equal (+20), so CRUSH is chosen to match the Bone mace.

name: Brutus

setups.label: Melee (free-to-play)
setups.notes: F2P boss after The Ides of Milk (Lumbridge cow field). Crush-defence armour (chainbody) helps; the cowbell amulet speeds up respawns.

setups.label: Magic (free-to-play)
setups.notes: Often outperforms melee at low levels; earth spells hit its 25% earth weakness.

setups.label: Ranged (free-to-play)
setups.notes: Green d'hide setup.

setups.label: Melee (members)
setups.notes: Members high-level setup from the wiki.

uncertain: All defence bonuses are negative, so attack style barely matters; SLASH chosen because the F2P table is scimitars.

name: Demonic Brutus

setups.label: Melee (slash)
setups.notes: Requires Desert Treasure II; feed Brutus an abyssal potato from the Scar. Specials always hit if not dodged, so Elite void + Void melee helm is a fine cheaper setup.

uncertain: Infobox has no Attribute field despite the name. Heavy ranged defence is only +110, but the wiki gives no ranged setup.

name: Shellbane gryphon

setups.label: Melee
setups.notes: Requires Troubled Tortugans and a gryphon Slayer task (or an elite clue). Knockback affects players under 40 kg worn weight, so wear heavy armour + Tortugan shield / Dragonfire shield.

uncertain: The wiki puts 'Tortugan shield' in the cape row of the gear table; confirm its equip slot. Combat 235 is the post-quest version.

Raid (2-8 players, released 20 Oct 2026), requires While Guthix Sleeps. Wiki raid-wide switches: Inquisitor's melee, Masori ranged, Ancestral magic; defence-drain specs (Elder maul, Dragon warhammer, Tonalztics of Ralos) are central.
